title: IT60105: Information Systems Design
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NoneGeneral methodologies for information systems design â
Structured approach, Object-oriented approach, Prototyping, Rational Unified
Process, CASE tools. Quality assurance in information systems â SEI CMM and ISO
9001. Coding methodologies â Standard coding techniques, Extreme programming.
Testing â Different aspects of testing, unit and system testing, regression
testing. Information system project management and Process metrics. Development
of typical information systems â Finance and Accounting, Inventory Control, Ecommerce.
